Rework cycle 1 for issue #105 complete — both review findings are fixed, verified for real, committed, pushed, and documented on PR #2023.
## What the review found (and what I fixed)
**Finding 1 — `sys.excepthook` was overwritten before the app ran; the P4 silent-crash scenario still produced no on-disk log.**
The GUI flow calls `UIRuntimeMixin.start()` (`src/airunner/app_mixins/ui_runtime_mixin.py:242`), which replaced the launcher-installed crash hook with `self.exception_handler` — that handler only printed to stderr and `sys.exit(1)`, so an uncaught exception during startup (e.g. a missing-import `NameError`) still died silently with no log.
- Fix: `src/airunner/crash_handler.py` now exposes public `report_uncaught_exception()` and `install_crash_handlers()` is idempotent (safe to re-arm). `UIRuntimeMixin.exception_handler()` forwards to the crash capture, and `UIRuntimeMixin.start()` re-arms `install_crash_handlers()` after installing its own hook.
**Finding 2 — faulthandler's file target was neutralized by `main.py`'s bare re-enable.**
`src/airunner/main.py` called bare `faulthandler.enable()`, resetting the output stream to stderr, so a native fault never reached `faulthandler.log`.
- Fix: extracted `install_faulthandler(log_dir)` (idempotent, creates the log dir, returns the fault-log path) in both `src/airunner/crash_handler.py` and `native/src/airunner_native/crash_handler.py`; `main.py` now calls `install_faulthandler()` and keeps the SIGUSR1 deadlock-debug `register`.
## Real verification (worktree source shadowing the main-repo editable installs via PYTHONPATH)
- Import smoke (all OK): `airunner.launcher`, `airunner.crash_handler`, `airunner.app_mixins.ui_runtime_mixin`, `airunner.main` (facehuggershield disabled — it blocks `.env` reads in this environment, pre-existing), `airunner_native.launcher`, `airunner_native.crash_handler`.
- `test_crash_handler.py`: **6 passed** (added tests: GUI exception handler forwards traceback to gui.log; re-install-after-overwrite re-arms capture; SIGSEGV dump lands in `faulthandler.log` after a bare re-enable; native crash handler appends to gui.log).
- `scripts/run_tests.py --unit`: **✅ All tests passed** (6 collected, 6 passed).
- Manual P4 repro (install → GUI hook overwrite → raise): traceback lands in `~/.local/share/airunner/logs/gui.log`.
- Manual fault repro (install → bare `faulthandler.enable()` → re-arm → SIGSEGV): dump lands in `faulthandler.log`, stderr clean.
## Boot check
Full GUI boot (daemon + Qt display) is not runnable in this headless worktree; the equivalent app-path validation is the subprocess tests above, which run the real installer and app-path raise/fault paths and assert the on-disk logs.
